source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of building statistical models (PDF 135).

blocks.text: Yeh hissa statistical models ki bunyadi eentein dekhta hai: un ki qismein, kaise banaye jate hain, aur un ki kaarkardagi kaise jaanchi jati hai, asal duniya ki misalon ke saath.

blocks.prompt: Is hisse mein sikhaye gaye teen models bataiye.
blocks.explanation: Linear regression, logistic regression aur K-means clustering.

items: Statistical models: qismein, banana aur jaanchna.
